 The Seller s and the Buyer entered into a n agreement to sell dated 31 st May, 2019 (the “ Agreement to Sell ”) in respect of the sale of the Property for total sale consider ation of an aggregate amount of Rs. 150,0 00,000 (Rupees one hundred and fifty million) , (the “ Sale Consideration ”) . Out of the Sale Consideration, the Buyer has paid an amount of Rs. 25 ,000,000 (Rupees twenty -five million) to the Sellers as an advance or Biana as part-payment towards Sale Consideration for the purchase of the Property (the “ Biana ”) through four (4) pay orders, details whereof are in the table below: 
 
 T he Parties agreed that the balance amount of the Sale Consideration after payment of Biana, that is an amount of Rs. 125 , 0 00,000 (Rupees one hundred and twenty-five million ) (the “ Balance Consideration ”) , shall be subject to execution of sale deed and transfer/conveyance of Property to the Buyer free from all encumbrances, mortgages charges, cesses, etc. (the “ Sale Deed ”), by the Seller for the sale and transfer of the Property in favo r of the Buyer. 
 
 T he Parties are desirous of entering into this Agreement on the terms and conditions stated therein. 
 
 NOW THEREFORE , in consideration of the mutual covenants and terms hereinafter set below it is hereby agreed as follows: 
 
 T he Sellers have executed the Sale Deed dated [●], in respect of the Property, in favour of the Buyer and the Seller s have sold , convey ed , assign ed , transferred and assure d unto the Buyer, along with peaceful possession, its full, absolute and unencumbered rights, title and interests in the Property on the terms and conditions stated herein. 
 
 T he Buyer hereby pays the entire Balance Consideration to the Seller through through four (4) pay orders, details whereof are in the table below. The Sellers acknowledge that they do not have any claim, in respect of the entire Sale Consideration, against the Buyer. Copies of the pay orders for the Balance Consideration are attached herewith as Schedule-II .

 The Parties agree that in the event that the P roperty is not free from encumbrances, such as dispute related to its title, lien, charge, benefit or any interest whatsoever, whether existing or created or purporting to exist or be created, and whether present, future or contingent, including those in the nature of sale, agreement to sell, pledge, hypothecation, mortgage, charge (whether fixed or floating), adverse possession, or any other rights or encumbrances generally or any other adverse claim of any kind whatsoever on the Property , preventing the Buyer from enjoying the Property, in whole or any part thereof, the Seller s shall be jointly and severally liable for any loss/damage to the Buyer . Said loss/damage shall at a minimum include: 
 
 loss of value due to defect of title, which loss shall be equivalent to the amount paid by the Buyer to the Seller s as Sale Consideration or the market value of the Property with no defect in title as determined by the Buyer , whichever is higher ; 
 
 the cost incurred by the Buyer on the development of the Property; and 
 
 
 any cost/expense incurred by the Buyer in undertaking the acquisition of the Property.
